description: Read a URL's declared metadata for a link preview: title, description, preview image, site name, favicon, canonical URL, language. This is what the page says about itself in its own meta tags, not a verified fact about it. Cheaper than read_url when you only need to know what a link is. Network: needs the target website. Optional packages: cheerio. Without them this tool reports what is missing instead of guessing.

url.description: The http(s) URL to unfurl. Fetching is SSRF-guarded.

name: unfurl_url
